QuestInfo.name: Black Wing Spy!
QuestInfo.0: Something happened at the Resistance Headquarters. Go see #b#p2151003##k at #b#m310010000##k to find out what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: A Black Wing spy? You've got time...why not find the spy yourself? Instead of going to the Secret Plaza where everyone else is, go search #b#m310010010##k.
QuestInfo.2: Was he really trying to hide from you with the power of darkness? You're a Demon Slayer...you can see right though such dark tricks! The Resistance really appreciates your help.

0.0: Oh, good. You're here. This probably has something to do with you...\r\n#L0##bI assume something has happened?#l\n#k
0.1: A Black Wing Spy has gotten into Resistance Headquarters. One of our guards spotted him, but he vanished in a black flash. If the spy is allowed to escape, the whole Resistance will be in danger.\r\n#L0##b(A spy, hm?)#l\n#k
0.2: He might even report about you, so I suggest laying low until we find the spy and dispose of him.\r\n#L0##b(I'm rather bored...perhaps I'll find the spy myself.)#l\n#k
0.3: Since this is an emergency, I'll end things here.

yes.0: Limit your movement around the base. In particular, stay away from #m310010010#, since it is not regularly patrolled.

no.0: Further information is restricted on a need-to-know basis.  Since you are not a full Resistance member, all you need to know is to stay out of the way.

1.0: You found the spy?! Incredible! How did you do that?

yes.0: The Hangar at the Training Room Entrance, eh? We searched there, too... Say, can you sense the dark energy their agents use? Is that it?
yes.1: Whatever your reasons are, you've been a huge help to the Resistance. Thank you so much.

default.0: #m310010010# is mostly unsecured, so stay away from there. The spy might be around there, so we're sending a team up as soon as they finish sweeping the other areas.
